Yapay zekâ projelerinde proje lideri ve ekip kaptanı.", "url": "https://sevgane.com/tr/", "image": "https://sevgane.com/img/yunusevgane.png", "email": "yunus@sevgane.com", "telephone": "+90 531 679 10 14", "knowsAbout": ["AI project management", "Large language models (LLM)", "Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)", "AI agents", "LLM fine-tuning", "AI governance (ISO/IEC 42001)", "Team building and leadership", "Remote team management", "Project management", "Agile (Scrum)", "Information security (ISO/IEC 27001)", "Full-stack DevOps", "Yapay zekâ proje yönetimi", "Yapay zekâ yönetişimi"], "sameAs": ["https://linkedin.com/in/yunusevgane", "https://github.com/yunusevgane", "https://instagram.com/yunusevgane", "https://twitter.com/yunusevgane"], "knowsLanguage": ["tr", "en"]}]}</script><style id="sevgane-tasarim">/* sevgane.com — tasarım yenileme (8 Kas 2026): Gece Lacivert + tek amber vurgu, Fraunces/Inter.
   Jetonlar --mx-site-* (desing.colors); bu blok yalnız tipografi ritmi, boşluk, yüzey ve hareketi kurar. */
:root{--sv-line:rgba(11,18,32,.14);--sv-muted:#44506A;--sv-body:#2B364D;--sv-soft:#3A465F;--sv-chip:#5C6B88;--sv-footer-bg:#E8EEF6;--sv-grad-hero:radial-gradient(900px 480px at 86% -8%,rgba(227,182,92,.30),transparent 62%),radial-gradient(760px 460px at 0% 108%,rgba(64,96,170,.12),transparent 62%),#F6F8FB;--sv-grad-stats:linear-gradient(180deg,#E8EEF6 0%,#F6F8FB 100%);--sv-grad-cta:radial-gradient(800px 360px at 100% 0%,rgba(227,182,92,.26),transparent 62%),linear-gradient(135deg,#E8EEF6 0%,#F3F6FB 100%);--sv-r:14px;--sv-dur:250ms}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-mx-scheme="light"]){--sv-line:rgba(233,237,245,.12);--sv-muted:#A9B4C8;--sv-body:var(--sv-body);--sv-soft:var(--sv-soft);--sv-chip:#7384A3;--sv-footer-bg:#080E1A;--sv-grad-hero:radial-gradient(900px 480px at 86% -8%,rgba(227,182,92,.15),transparent 62%),radial-gradient(760px 460px at 0% 108%,rgba(64,96,170,.24),transparent 62%),#0B1220;--sv-grad-stats:linear-gradient(180deg,#0E1830 0%,#0B1220 100%);--sv-grad-cta:radial-gradient(800px 360px at 100% 0%,rgba(227,182,92,.13),transparent 62%),linear-gradient(135deg,#14213A 0%,#0F1A30 100%)}}
html[data-mx-scheme="dark"]{--sv-line:rgba(233,237,245,.12);--sv-muted:#A9B4C8;--sv-body:var(--sv-body);--sv-soft:var(--sv-soft);--sv-chip:#7384A3;--sv-footer-bg:#080E1A;--sv-grad-hero:radial-gradient(900px 480px at 86% -8%,rgba(227,182,92,.15),transparent 62%),radial-gradient(760px 460px at 0% 108%,rgba(64,96,170,.24),transparent 62%),#0B1220;--sv-grad-stats:linear-gradient(180deg,#0E1830 0%,#0B1220 100%);--sv-grad-cta:radial-gradient(800px 360px at 100% 0%,rgba(227,182,92,.13),transparent 62%),linear-gradient(135deg,#14213A 0%,#0F1A30 100%)}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:var(--mx-font-sans);background:var(--mx-site-bg);color:var(--mx-site-text);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;line-height:1.65}
#content h1,#content h2,#content h3,#footer h2,#footer h3{font-family:var(--mx-font-heading);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.018em}
::selection{background:var(--mx-site-primary);color:var(--mx-site-primary-contrast)}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--mx-site-primary);outline-offset:3px}
/* Hero: ortalı, geniş boşluk, serif display, amber hairline */
#content [class*="-hero2"]:not([class*="-hero2-"]){min-height:680px}
#content [class*="-hero2-container"]{max-width:1000px;padding:132px 24px 120px}
#content [class*="-hero2-badge"]{background:transparent;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--mx-site-primary) 50%,transparent);color:var(--mx-site-primary);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;padding:9px 22px;backdrop-filter:none;margin-bottom:34px}
#content [class*="-hero2-title"]{font-family:var(--mx-font-heading);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(2.35rem,5.2vw,4.25rem);line-height:1.07;letter-spacing:-.028em;max-width:920px;margin-bottom:26px}
#content [class*="-hero2-title"]::after{content:"";display:block;width:64px;height:2px;background:var(--mx-site-primary);margin:30px auto 0}
#content [class*="-hero2-desc"]{color:var(--sv-soft);font-size:1.18rem;line-height:1.75;max-width:690px;margin-bottom:44px}
#content [class*="-hero2-btn"]{border-radius:8px;min-height:52px;letter-spacing:.01em;box-shadow:none;transition:transform var(--sv-dur) ease-out,background-color var(--sv-dur) ease-out,border-color var(--sv-dur) ease-out}
#content [class*="-hero2-btn-primary"]{background:var(--mx-site-primary);color:var(--mx-site-primary-contrast)}
#content [class*="-hero2-btn-secondary"]{background:transparent;color:var(--mx-site-text);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--mx-site-text) 30%,transparent)}
#content [class*="-hero2-btn-secondary"]:hover{border-color:var(--mx-site-primary);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mx-site-primary) 8%,transparent)}
/* Bölüm başlıkları ve kartlar: bol boşluk, ince çizgi, ton ile yükselti (gölge yok) */
#content h2{line-height:1.18}
#content [class*="-values-title"]{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.4vw,2.7rem)}
#content [class*="-values"]:not([class*="-values-"]){padding-block:104px}
#content [class*="-values-card"]:not([class*="-values-card-"]){border:1px solid var(--sv-line);border-radius:var(--sv-r);box-shadow:none;transition:transform var(--sv-dur) ease-out,border-color var(--sv-dur) ease-out}
#content [class*="-values-card"]:not([class*="-values-card-"]):hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mx-site-primary) 45%,transparent)}
/* İç sayfa gövdesi: ortalı okunur sütun (≈72ch), güçlü h2, amber bağlantı */
#content section:not([class])>*{max-width:72ch;margin-inline:auto}
#content section:not([class]){padding:56px 24px 96px}
#content section:not([class])>h2{margin-block:2.4em .6em;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,2.8vw,2.2rem)}
#content section:not([class])>h3{margin-block:2em .5em;font-size:1.35rem;color:var(--mx-site-text)}
#content section:not([class])>h4{margin-block:1.6em .4em;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--mx-site-primary);font-family:var(--mx-font-sans);font-weight:600}
#content section:not([class])>p,#content section:not([class])>ul,#content section:not([class])>ol{font-size:1.04rem;line-height:1.8;color:var(--sv-body)}
#content section:not([class]) li{margin:.35em 0}
#content section:not([class]) a{color:var(--mx-site-primary);text-underline-offset:3px;text-decoration-thickness:1px}
#content section:not([class]) a:hover{text-decoration-thickness:2px}
#content section:not([class]) img{border-radius:var(--sv-r);border:1px solid var(--sv-line)}
#content [class*="-stats-number"]{font-family:var(--mx-font-heading);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
/* Sayfa başlığı bandı */
#content [class*="-title"] h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3.1rem);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.025em;text-shadow:none}
#content [class*="-oz-chip"]:not([aria-pressed="true"]){background:var(--mx-site-surface-2);border-color:var(--sv-chip)}
#content [class*="-pd5-cta-wa"]{background:var(--mx-site-surface-2);border-color:var(--sv-line)}
/* WhatsApp: tek vurgu rengi */
a.whatsapp{background:var(--mx-site-primary)!important;color:var(--mx-site-primary-contrast)!important;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
a.whatsapp *{color:inherit!important;fill:currentColor}
/* Altbilgi */
#footer{border-top:1px solid var(--sv-line)}
/* Çerez bandı: motor cookie.css'indeki .cookie-banner (480px kart, translateX(-50%)) modül şeridini bozuyordu */
.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie]{left:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:auto;max-width:none;transform:none;border-radius:0;padding:0;animation:none;font-family:var(--mx-font-sans)}
/* Hareket: yalnız tek sefer giriş; azaltılmış harekette kapalı */
@keyframes svUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){#content section:not([class])>*{animation:svUp .5s ease-out both}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}*{animation-duration:.001ms!important;transition-duration:.001ms!important}}
@media (max-width:768px){#content [class*="-hero2-container"]{padding:88px 20px 80px}#content [class*="-values"]:not([class*="-values-"]){padding-block:72px}}

/* Blog (8 Kas 2026): liste + yazı; aynı iç sayfa sütunu, jetonlar --mx-site-* */
#content .sv-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.25rem .6rem;align-items:center;margin:0 0 1.4rem;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sv-muted)}
#content .sv-meta .sv-cat{color:var(--mx-site-primary);font-weight:600}
#content .sv-meta .sv-dot{opacity:.6}
#content section:not([class]) .sv-lead{font-family:var(--mx-font-heading);font-size:clamp(1.15rem,2vw,1.38rem);line-height:1.6;color:var(--mx-site-text);margin:0 auto 2.2rem;padding-bottom:2.2rem;max-width:648px;width:100%;border-bottom:1px solid var(--sv-line)}
#content section:not([class])>article>h2{margin-block:2.4em .6em;font-size:clamp(1.45rem,2.6vw,1.95rem)}
#content section:not([class])>article>p,#content section:not([class])>article>ul,#content section:not([class])>article>ol{font-size:1.04rem;line-height:1.8;color:var(--sv-body)}
#content section:not([class])>article>ul,#content section:not([class])>article>ol{padding-inline-start:1.3em;list-style:disc}
#content section:not([class])>.sv-post{width:100%;padding:2.2rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--sv-line)}
#content section:not([class])>.sv-lead+.sv-post{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
#content section:not([class])>.sv-post h2{margin:0 0 .6rem;font-size:clamp(1.45rem,2.8vw,1.95rem);line-height:1.22}
#content .sv-post h2 a{font-size:inherit;font-family:inherit;font-weight:inherit;line-height:inherit;color:var(--mx-site-text);text-decoration:none;transition:color var(--sv-dur) ease-out}
#content .sv-post h2 a:hover{color:var(--mx-site-primary)}
#content .sv-post p{margin:0 0 .8rem;font-size:1.04rem;line-height:1.75;color:var(--sv-body)}
#content .sv-post .sv-meta{margin-bottom:.9rem}
#content .sv-readmore{font-weight:600}
#content .sv-readmore a{text-decoration:none}
#content .sv-readmore a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
#content .sv-author{margin-top:3.2rem;padding:1.5rem 1.6rem;background:var(--mx-site-surface-2);border:1px solid var(--sv-line);border-radius:var(--sv-r)}
#content .sv-author strong,#content .sv-more strong{display:block;margin-bottom:.4rem;font-family:var(--mx-font-heading);font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--mx-site-text)}
#content .sv-author p{margin:.3rem 0;font-size:.98rem;line-height:1.7;color:var(--sv-body)}
#content .sv-more{margin-top:2rem}
#content .sv-more ul{margin:.3rem 0 .6rem;padding-inline-start:1.2em;list-style:disc;font-size:1rem}
#content .sv-readmore{font-size:1rem}

/* Tema (8 Kas 2026, yunus/20261108-084135-ygcf): açık/koyu. Paletler desing.colors.lite/dark; sistem tercihi + html[data-mx-scheme] (düğme, localStorage "sv-theme").
   Logo: koyu temada logo-acik.png, açıkta logo.png — iki img, CSS seçer (plaka yok). */
.sv-logo-dark{display:none!important}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-mx-scheme="light"]) .sv-logo-light{display:none!important}:root:not([data-mx-scheme="light"]) .sv-logo-dark{display:block!important}}
html[data-mx-scheme="dark"] .sv-logo-light{display:none!important}
html[data-mx-scheme="dark"] .sv-logo-dark{display:block!important}
.sv-theme-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;width:36px;height:36px;padding:0;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 40%,transparent);border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--mx-site-text);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color var(--sv-dur) ease-out,background-color var(--sv-dur) ease-out}
.sv-theme-btn:hover{border-color:var(--mx-site-primary);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mx-site-primary) 12%,transparent)}
.sv-theme-btn svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;pointer-events:none}
.sv-theme-btn .sv-ico-sun{display:none}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-mx-scheme="light"]) .sv-theme-btn .sv-ico-sun{display:block}:root:not([data-mx-scheme="light"]) .sv-theme-btn .sv-ico-moon{display:none}}
html[data-mx-scheme="dark"] .sv-theme-btn .sv-ico-sun{display:block}
html[data-mx-scheme="dark"] .sv-theme-btn .sv-ico-moon{display:none}
#content [class*="-hero2-title"]{color:var(--mx-site-text)}
#content [class*="-cta-title"]{color:var(--mx-site-text)}
#content [class*="-cta-desc"]{color:var(--sv-soft)}
#content [class*="-cta-btn-secondary"],#content a[class*="-cta-btn-secondary"],#content [class*="-cta-btn-secondary"]>*{color:var(--mx-site-text)!important}
#content [class*="-cta-btn-secondary"]{background:transparent;border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mx-site-text) 35%,transparent)}
#content [class*="-cta-btn-primary"]:hover{background-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mx-site-primary) 88%,var(--mx-site-text))}
/* Vaka kartı (Projeler › Pazaryeri): Uzaktan çalışma bandı / yazar kartıyla aynı yüzey-çizgi-yarıçap kalıbı */
#content .sv-case{margin:2.2rem auto;padding:1.5rem 1.6rem;background:var(--mx-site-surface);border:1px solid var(--sv-line);border-radius:var(--sv-r);scroll-margin-top:24px}
#content .sv-case h3{margin:0 0 .8rem!important;font-size:1.3rem!important}
#content .sv-case ul{margin:.3rem 0 .9rem;padding-inline-start:1.2em;list-style:disc;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.7;color:var(--sv-body)}
#content .sv-case p{margin:0;font-size:.92rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--sv-muted)}

/* Çerez bandı (9 Kas 2026, yunus/20261108-090706-g5tf): ince şerit, başlık+metin tek satır; yalnız «Tümünü kabul et» dolu, «Reddet»/«Tercihler» aynı boyutta çerçeveli.
   Sınıf ön eki render'da değiştiği için (modulex→f0002) düğmeler veri özniteliğiyle seçilir. */
.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] [class*="-cb2-satir"]{padding-block:8px;gap:8px 20px}
.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] [class*="-cb2-metin"]{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:0 10px}
.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] [class*="-cb2-metin"] p{margin:0!important}
.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] [class*="-cb2-h"]{font-size:.9rem!important}
.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] [class*="-cb2-p"]{font-size:.85rem!important;line-height:1.45!important}
.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] button[data-mx-cookie-accept],.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] button[data-mx-cookie-reject],.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] button[data-mx-cookie-prefs],.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] button[data-mx-cookie-save]{min-width:0;min-height:40px;padding:0 16px;font-size:.85rem;border-radius:8px;flex:0 0 auto;transition:background-color var(--sv-dur) ease-out,border-color var(--sv-dur) ease-out,color var(--sv-dur) ease-out}
.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] button[data-mx-cookie-reject],.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] button[data-mx-cookie-prefs],.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] button[data-mx-cookie-save]{background:transparent;color:var(--mx-site-text);border:1.5px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--mx-site-text) 60%,transparent);font-weight:600}
.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] button[data-mx-cookie-reject]:hover,.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] button[data-mx-cookie-prefs]:hover,.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] button[data-mx-cookie-save]:hover{border-color:var(--mx-site-primary);color:var(--mx-site-primary);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mx-site-primary) 10%,transparent)}
.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] button[data-mx-cookie-accept]:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mx-site-primary) 66%,var(--mx-site-text));border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mx-site-primary) 66%,var(--mx-site-text))}
@media (max-width:900px){.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] [class*="-cb2-p"]{font-size:.8rem!important}
.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] [class*="-cb2-dugmeler"]{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1.5fr;gap:8px}
.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] button[data-mx-cookie-accept],.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] button[data-mx-cookie-reject],.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] button[data-mx-cookie-prefs],.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie] button[data-mx-cookie-save]{padding:0 8px;min-height:44px}}
/* WhatsApp düğmesi çerez bandının üstüne çıkar (bant yüksekliği --mx-cookie-pad, altbilgi komut dosyası ayarlar) */
a.whatsapp{margin-bottom:var(--mx-cookie-pad,0px)}
</style>
